Doctoral programmes (PhD & EngD)
Have you completed your master’s degree and wish to become a leading researcher? If so, consider a PhD or EngD position at the University of Twente.
The Twente Graduate School (TGS) coordinates all doctoral programmes at UT. You can either choose a four-year research-oriented PhD Programme, which leads to a PhD degree (Doctor degree in Dutch) or a more practical, two-year design-oriented Engineering Doctorate programme, which leads to an EngD degree upon successful completion.
Each programme focuses on topics closely related to the work carried out by our faculties and research institutes, and is taught and supervised by expert researchers and designers.
Interested in PhD programme?
A PhD prepares you to become an independent researcher through original research, a dissertation, and a personalised 30 EC training programme combining disciplinary and transferable skills. Explore programme, admission requirements, and vacancies.
Interested in EngD programme?
A two-year professional doctorate in engineering that combines university courses with an industry design project. Gain hands-on experience and create impact for companies and organisations. Explore programmes, admission requirements, and vacancies.
